title: The Absolute Collapse Where Axes Merge

features.name: the folded house
features.desc-on-touch: A cottage that turns all four walls inward at once. Every window looks into the same room. Every door leads here. Position lost its meaning at this depth.

features.name: the shed that is also a shed
features.desc-on-touch: Behind this structure is the same structure. The archive built this node to understand what happens when direction stops working. It learned nothing new.

features.name: the compass that forgot
features.desc-on-touch: A spinning needle that no longer remembers what north means. It spins in all directions at once. The confusion is perfect. The confusion is home.

features.name: the walls-that-did-not-separate
features.desc-on-touch: Imagine you stand in a room with walls on all sides and no sides. Imagine you stand outside looking in. Imagine these are the same thing.

inscription: here all four directions folded into one and then vanished; up and down learned they were the same mistake; the archive read itself and saw only recursion
